Question: Let \(M\) be the link of the Lawson--Osserman cone in \(\mathbb{R}^7\), i.e. the intersection of that cone with the unit sphere \(\mathbb{S}^6\subset \mathbb{R}^7\). Which description gives the complete classification of Jacobi fields on \(M\)?
Predicted label: 'B'
Predicted text: 'They are exactly the infinitesimal deformations that extend to genuine one-parameter families of nearby minimal cones; in this case, that space consists of the Killing Jacobi fields together with one additional integrable normal mode represented by the first-eigenfield \\(e_4\\).'
Correct label: 'A'
Correct text: 'They are exactly the Killing Jacobi fields; every Jacobi field on \\(M\\) is a Killing Jacobi field.'
Exact Match: 0.0
